patch.description:
Correct a saved location, or apply a verified place-search result to it, in place.

The location is reusable: every linked stay, visit, route end and update
reads the corrected address and map target from this same record. Its id,
area, visibility and sharing choices are never changed by a map-target update.

Editing what visitors read (public name, city, country, a shared address,
or the area its visits and route ends are filed under) on a location with
live receivers is refused with 409 until the request sets
``acknowledge_visitor_changes``; the refusal lists each field's before and
after and the audiences. An acknowledged change is recorded in the audit trail.

delete.description: Delete an unused location; refuse while any visit, stay, route or reisupdate still points at it.

get.description: Expose connection state without ever returning an access token.

undoable.title: Undoable

audiences.title: Audiences

exclusions.description: A live scope change that added or removed exclusions, and what removing them newly showed.

others.title: Others
others.description: An `alternative_group.choose`: what happened to the other members.

AuditEventDetails.title: AuditEventDetails
AuditEventDetails.description:
What an event records, never authored content. Only the keys an event kind sets are present; the keys named
here are the ones clients read, and an event may carry further ids or counts of its own.

AuditEventKind.title: AuditEventKind

The code list of sharing audit events. The column is a plain string checked against this list when a row is
written, so adding a kind needs no migration.

AuditReasonInput.title: AuditReasonInput

An optional owner-entered reason attached to a lifecycle-transition
audit event; never required, since most transitions are self-explanatory.

id.title: Id

cover.title: Cover

preset.title: Preset

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: Stored exclusions that no longer apply (the record was deleted or is no longer set to everyone). They are ignored and dropped by the next write.

baseline.title: Baseline

preset.description: Optionally start from a sharing preset instead of the public baseline: it is applied in the same transaction, after the audience is created, through the same code and rules as the preset apply route. Absent means no preset ('same as the public page').

preset_exceptions.description: Null when no preset was applied. Owner-only.

confirm_widening.title: Confirm Widening
confirm_widening.description: Set to true to accept that removing exclusions from a live (active) audience shows its visitors records they did not receive. Without it such a change is refused with 409 exclusion_widening_needs_acknowledgement, which lists the records, and nothing changes. Drafts need no acknowledgement. Not stored.

defaults.description: The audience-level date cap. Absent when it sets none, so each record's own value applies.

numbers.title: Numbers

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Records set to everyone that this hidden link or collection member does not receive.

ShareScope.title: ShareScope
ShareScope.description: What one audience receives, as stored. A setting the owner never made is absent rather than null.

date_precision.description: The finest date a visitor of this audience may read: day, month or year. It caps every record's date (and the trip dates) on top of the record's own setting, and the coarser of the two wins. null or absent sets no cap, so each record's own value applies (month when it has none).

ShareScopeDefaultsInput.title: ShareScopeDefaultsInput

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.description: Opt-in visitor figures from the finished projection only: days with day-precise shared updates, explicit shared areas, countries in those areas and the union of day-precise shared stay nights. Never trip totals. Omitted preserves the stored choice; null or [] clears it. Presets preserve it.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Records set to everyone (the public baseline) that this hidden link or collection member does NOT receive, on top of its custom `items`. Each is removed from this audience only, together with the records that depend on it: an excluded area or location also hides the locations in it and the visits, stays, routes and updates that use it; an excluded update hides its photos; an excluded cover photo leaves this audience without a cover. Adding an exclusion narrows the audience; removing one on a live link or collection widens it and needs confirm_widening. The public view is the baseline and cannot exclude anything (422 scope_exclusion_not_allowed). An id not on this trip is refused; a record that is no longer set to everyone is dropped by the write. Absent keeps the stored exclusions; null or [] clears them. The response's `exclusions` names what each one also hides.

both are given the location must be in that area.
